programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: Sampling cutting-edge sweet creations; coconut cremeaux at The Pig and The Lady in Honolulu; whole vanilla bean ice cream by the creator of the Cronut in New York City; raspberry ice box cake at Sweet Lulu's Bakery on Wheels in Charleston.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: Snow Monster in Long Beach offers ice cream creations such as macaron ice cream sandwiches and drinks topped with clouds of cotton candy; Santa Ana's Cauldron Ice Cream specializes in small batches made with liquid nitrogen served in waffle cones.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: The Doughnut Project in New York City offers a chocolate cream doughnut flavored with bone marrow; Sweetness Bake Shop in Miami offers a cinnamon-spice doughnut filled with dulce de leche and topped in chocolate frosting and a crispy churro.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: The Salty Donut offers a buttery 24-hour brioche doughnut dough and serve topping combinations like key lime pie and peach bourbon; L.A. Sweetz offers a coconut cake dipped in dark rum and topped with dulce de leche buttercream.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: Brain Freeze Nitrogen Ice Cream Lab in Miami offers a mad scientist challenge to eat 30 scoops of ice cream in 30 minutes; Spot Dessert Bar in New York City serves Asian-inspired plated desserts, including a twist on the classic chocolate lava cake.

programs.title: Spring Baking Championship
programs.desc: Host Molly Yeh brings her love of coffee and tea to the competition with oversized stuffed coffee cookies in the pre-heat; it's tea for two as the bakers must team up and work together to win over the judges with a delicious dessert platter.
